info.author: xcode
info.comment: Seamless flat vector background texture: civic graph paper. Pale ice #F4F7FB field with a faint cool gray #C5CDD6 square grid and a slightly stronger navy line every fifth square. Extremely understated, tileable stationery, no objects, no text, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, clean geometric lines.
